```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(vroom)
library(ggpubr)

today <- Sys.Date()
```

## historical vs modern pairings

```{r}
pairings <- read.csv("../data/comb_hist+1001g.prs_geo+gen.csv")

historical <- pairings[, 1:2]

historical$type <- "historical"

colnames(historical) <- gsub("historical_", "", colnames(historical))

modern <- pairings[, 5:6]

modern$type <- "modern"

colnames(modern) <- gsub("modern_", "", colnames(modern))

slim_pairings <- rbind(historical, modern)

slim_pairings$time <- slim_pairings$year - min(slim_pairings$year) + 1

slim_pairings <- slim_pairings %>% group_by(type, time) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% arrange(time, .by_group = T)

slim_pairings$ID = 1:nrow(slim_pairings)

write.table(slim_pairings, "../config/sampling_times.tsv", quote = F, row.names = F, sep = "\t")

sum(slim_pairings$n)

```

## Fst - historical vs modern

```{r}
cutoff = 0.05

msprime <- vroom(
  "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/fst-time-series-simulations/workflow/msprime_fst.txt",
  delim = "\t",
  col_names = F
)

# NOTE: the original chunk (03_linked_selection.Rmd, grenenet-phase2 @ 5cad5b7)
# indexed `fst$X1` here, but `fst` was never defined anywhere in that notebook;
# corrected to the intended self-reference `msprime$X1`.
msprime$ID <- as.numeric(gsub(".*/|.txt", "", msprime$X1))

names(msprime)[2] = "msprime_fst"

gcta <- vroom(
  "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/fst-time-series-simulations/workflow/gcta_fst.txt",
  delim = "\t",
  col_names = F
)

gcta$ID <- as.numeric(gsub(".*/|.fst:1", "", gcta$X1))

gcta <- gcta %>% group_by(ID) %>% summarize(gcta_fst = mean(X7), S = n())

gcta_msprime <- merge(msprime, gcta, by = "ID")

# compare gcta and msprime
nei_weir_fst <- ggplot(gcta_msprime, aes(x = msprime_fst, y = gcta_fst)) +
  geom_point(shape = 16) +
  #geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, lwd = 1.2, color = "green") +
  labs(x = "Nei 1973 Fst (msprime)", y = "Weir 1996 Fst (gcta)")

# merge with window sizes and calculate p-values
params <- vroom(
  "/global/scratch/users/milesroberts/fst-time-series-simulations/config/fst_params.tsv",
  delim = "\t"
)

params_fst <- merge(params, gcta_msprime, by = "ID")

params_fst %>% 
  #filter(gcta_fst > 0) %>% 
  group_by(L) %>% 
  summarize(upb = quantile(gcta_fst, probs = 1 - cutoff/2, na.rm = T),
            lwb = quantile(gcta_fst, probs = cutoff / 2, na.rm = T),
            ost1_filter_test = 1 - ecdf(gcta_fst)(0.003892181),
            erecta_filter_test = 1 - ecdf(gcta_fst)(0.032451811),
            ost_unfilter_test = 1 - ecdf(gcta_fst)(0.011700622),
            erecta_unfilter_test = 1 - ecdf(gcta_fst)(0.014078437))

# tact distribution of fst from gcta
fst_density <- ggplot(params_fst, aes(x = gcta_fst)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(L~., ncol = 1, labeller = "label_both") +
  geom_vline(data = filter(params_fst, L == 3081), aes(xintercept = 0.003892181), lty = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(params_fst, L == 3081), aes(xintercept = 0.011700622), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(params_fst, L == 6583), aes(xintercept = 0.032451811), lty = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = filter(params_fst, L == 6583), aes(xintercept = 0.014078437), lty = 2) +
  labs(x = "Neutral Weir 1996 Fst\n(Sampling desing, Ne = 20,000)")


ggarrange(fst_density, nei_weir_fst, ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"), font.label = list(size = 16, family = "Helvetica"))

ggsave(paste("../results/", today, "/baseline_fst_historical_modern.pdf", sep = ""), height = 4, width = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
```
